notes.title: VR2 - Extras released (Soundtrack, Guide, Concepts)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32530457/dff0dc090026be61d0c10895baea05e34add97be.jpg[/img]

Good News!

You can now get the Extras from [b]VR2: Vacate 2 Rooms[/b] in a DLC Bundle:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/930180/VR2_Vacate_2_Rooms__Extras/]Get the Extras here[/url]

[h2]The Contents are this:[/h2]
[list]
 [*]5 music tracks: 1 Soundtrack, 1 Drum'N'Base Remix, 1 Original, 2 Bonus Tracks
 [*]VR2: Vacate 2 Rooms - Concept Book
 [*]Walkthrough Guide (Spoiler Alert!)
[/list]

[h2]Music Tracks:[/h2]
[list]
[*]1 Vacate 2 Rooms - Soundtrack
[*]2 Vacate the Room - Sountrack (Drum & Bass Remix)
[*]3 Vacate the Room - Sountrack (Classic Music Tracker Version)
[*]4 Bonus Track - The Quest for the BIG KEY
[*]5 Bonus Track - hOSHIs Elektronauts
[/list]

Have fun reading the Guide, taking a look at the scribbles and game-design concepts and listening to the music.

Greetings

hOSHI*

notes.title: Out of Early Access!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32530457/94277f2e5f2820f29a16e9f155ce4be4432e908d.png[/img]

Good News!

VR2: Vacate 2 Rooms is finally out of Early Access. 
And with this a few things changed:
[list]
[*]We now have 6 languages: EN, DE, RU, HE, PT, PT-BR (more to follow)
[*]The rotating elevator now turns more slowly (testers swear it's less uncomfortable)
[*]Items will be kept from falling out of that elevator
[*]Also a lot of bugs were fixed
[/list]

So please have fun and remember:
The secret ending is still to be found! 
If you're a Youtube Channel - be fast. You might be the first to release footage of it.

Greetings

hOSHI*
